input.content: Write a Next.js App Router page, as a client component in TypeScript, that converts temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin. Typing into any of the three fields updates the other two, and the page warns when the value is below absolute zero. Put the whole page in one file.

Using Next.js and TypeScript, build a reading-list page where I can add a book with a title and an optional author, tick books off once I have read them, and see how many are still unread. Everything goes in page.tsx; no backend is needed.

I want a React component in TypeScript, styled with Tailwind, that shows sixteen color swatches in a 4x4 grid. Clicking a swatch copies its hex code to the clipboard and briefly shows which color was copied. Keep it to a single .tsx module.

Make a stopwatch as a React + TypeScript component with Tailwind classes: start/stop, reset, and a lap button that records the current time. Show laps newest first with their number, and format times as mm:ss.cc. One .tsx module please.

Create a memory matching game with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript (no frameworks): eight pairs of face-down cards, two cards flipped per turn, matched pairs stay face up, a move counter, a message when every pair is found, and a button to reshuffle. Deliver it as one .html document.
